### `unhype` (16)

| ID | Concept | Method | Status | Takeaway |
|----|---------|--------|--------|----------|
| [exp016](archive/unhype/exp016_unhype_fire/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | Direct port of the published hypernet (rank-1, S=50, small simulated_lr). No change vs base (FDR 1.0) — later traced to the dead-LoRA-init trap. |
| [exp017](archive/unhype/exp017_helios_smoke_test/notes.md) | none | smoke_test | done | Helios smoke test for the unhype job path. Not an unlearning result. |

| [exp019](archive/unhype/exp019_unhype_fire_diagnostics/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | Diagnostics run that confirmed the exp016 failure mode: the trajectory never leaves the zero-init, so the removal loss is trivially satisfied. FDR 1.0. |
| [exp020](archive/unhype/exp020_unhype_fire_gentle/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | Gentle (preservation-first) setting. No change vs base — two compounding bugs: constant-output hypernet init and a simulated_lr ~40-200x too small. |
| [exp021](archive/unhype/exp021_unhype_fire_moderate/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | Moderate setting. No change vs base; same two bugs as exp020, fixed in exp023. |
| [exp022](archive/unhype/exp022_unhype_fire_aggressive/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | Aggressive setting. No change vs base; same two bugs as exp020/021. |
| [exp023](archive/unhype/exp023_unhype_fire_calibrated/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | First run on the fixed init, simulated_lr 0.005 -> 0.3. Still a no-op adapter (FDR 1.0, theta frozen at init) — the MSE gradient-matching target could not move theta. |
| [exp024](archive/unhype/exp024_unhype_fire_bigger_simlr/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | simulated_lr 0.3 -> 30 to close the endpoint-scale gap. Still a no-op adapter; matching norms leaves the MSE dominated by the direction it cannot align. |
| [exp025](archive/unhype/exp025_unhype_fire_cosine_remove/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | Cosine removal loss to decouple direction from magnitude. The adapter finally moved (theta 15.16 -> 17.06, videos changed) but in the wrong direction — no erasure. |
| [exp026](archive/unhype/exp026_unhype_fire_stronger_guidance/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | negative_guidance_scale 1 -> 3 to give the steered ESD target a real erasure direction. Cosine stayed pinned ~1; bottleneck is upstream of the removal loss. |
| [exp027](archive/unhype/exp027_unhype_fire_variance_reduced/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | Averaged the removal target over K=8 timestep snapshots to cut variance. Cosine only 0.99 -> 0.97 — the dominant variance source was elsewhere (prompt conditioning). |
| [exp028](archive/unhype/exp028_unhype_distill_control/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | Offline distillation control: train the hypernet toward exp006's known-good theta*. Inconclusive — mean-reduced MSE over 8.26M elements plus Adafactor never moved the output layer, so it tested the optimizer, not the method. |
| [exp029](archive/unhype/exp029_unhype_promptvar_stepfix/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | Prompt-variance reduction + step-embedding fix. Diverged (theta-norm -> 1853); the FDR 0.0 is noise output, not erasure — CLIP collapsed on unrelated too. |
| [exp030](archive/unhype/exp030_unhype_static_apply_control/notes.md) | fire | unhype | done | Static-apply control, zero training: injecting theta* directly erases fire (FDR 0.6, colorfulness 22.6 -> 9.0) while unrelated holds. Proves the decode/apply/eval path is sound, so every exp024-exp028 failure is upstream in the online learning signal. |
| [exp031](archive/unhype/exp031_unhype_cosine_stabilized/notes.md) | fire | unhype | superseded | Per-prompt conditioning fix + stabilized cosine — the best online run (FDR 0.4 at step 150) but it then leaks back. End of the unhype thread. |
